entities.name: Lisha
entities.description: Human ship captain and privateer of Bant, who rejected her role as princess of Jhess.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: Shard of Alara where Lisha dwells.

entities.name: Jhess
entities.description: Land whose princess role Lisha rejected.

events.summary: Lisha rejected her formal role as princess of Jhess and became a privateer.
events.quote: Lisha rejected her formal role as princess of Jhess and became a privateer.

events.summary: Lisha raids Jhessian ports and distributes loot to her crew and the poor, always escaping the cavalry.
events.quote: Lisha has always escaped to her ship before the Jhessian cavalry could catch her.
